subject: Vendr staged-upload handshake & presign window
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <uploader@vendr.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: jen.cho@vendr.com
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged upload kickoff for BrightLeaf - presign details

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the intro yesterday. We want to start the staged evidence upload for BrightLeaf next week and need to confirm a few operational details for presign links and acceptance checks so our uploader can run without hitting ACL errors.

High level asks: 
- Preferred S3 prefix you want us to use (we can respect a single tenant prefix)
- Presign TTL max for each object (our system defaults to 24h but we can support shorter windows)
- Any required manifest schema (hash algorithm + filename column)

I attached a short checklist of required fields from our side and a sample manifest. Can you confirm whether Redwood will run an acceptance job that verifies checksums and CAIQ mapping after upload? If so, is there an SLA window we should expect before items become available in the portal?

Att: brightleaf-manifest-sample.csv

Cheers,
Jen Cho
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
jen.cho@vendr.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Vendr Onboarding <uploader@vendr.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged upload kickoff for BrightLeaf - presign details

Jen — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (security intake) and Camila (evidence ops) to confirm the acceptance flow. Fast answers below, and we can tighten in a short call if helpful.

S3 prefix: s3://redwood-inference-vendr-uploads/brightleaf/ — please create per-run subfolders under that prefix (e.g., /run-2026-04-26/).
Presign TTL: we can accept up to 12 hours per link. If you need >12h for retry windows we can support 24h for scheduled bulk windows, but prefer 4–6h default for interactive runs.
Manifest: see attached sample — we require filename, sha256, size_bytes and a 'questionnaire_id' column to tag CAIQ/SIG items. Use sha256.
Acceptance job & SLA: our ingestion pipeline runs lightweight checks (manifest parity, checksum) within 30 minutes of upload. Full mapping to CAIQ fields (quality stage) is asynchronous and typically completes within 24 hours. If anything fails the job will post a failure row to the manifest-reports/ folder and email the intake alias.

Attaching: upload-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (simple matrix with required checks and fail semantics).

If that works we'll propose a 2-hour staging window on Tue 2026-04-27 02:00–04:00 UTC for your bulk backfill. Please confirm the run id and point person.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Evidence Ops (onboarding)
Redwood Inference
From: Jen Cho <jen.cho@vendr.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: uploader@vendr.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 07:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged upload kickoff for BrightLeaf - presign details

Thanks Dylan — this is helpful. Couple of clarifying Qs before we finalize the window:
1) For the 4–6h default, will the presigned PUT expire and cause the object to be rejected if the upload is interrupted? We can retry against the same presign if within TTL but want to understand your expectations for partial objects and resumable uploads.
2) For manifest-reports/, what's the filename convention for failures so our automation can poll reliably?
3) Is there an allowlist for the uploader IPs or should we rely on presign-only access?

Our proposed point-of-contact is me (jen.cho@vendr.com). The canonical run id for the bulk job will be run-brightleaf-0427. We will use multipart uploads but finish individual parts within the same presign session (we can provide an S3-compatible presign flow).

Att: brightleaf-manifest-sample.csv (updated with run id)

- Jen
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Jen Cho <jen.cho@vendr.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged upload kickoff for BrightLeaf - presign details

Jen — good questions. Answering inline: 
1) Presign behavior: presigned PUTs are single-use for the object key created. If a multipart upload is used, the presign we issue supports completing the multipart within TTL; if parts remain incomplete after TTL we will invalidate and the partial multipart will be subject to S3 lifecycle (we do not auto-clean immediate). For reliability please aim for 6h TTL for multipart run-brightleaf-0427. If you expect network flakiness, tell us and we will issue 24h batch links for that run.

2) Failure reports: we write CSVs to s3://redwood-inference-vendr-uploads/brightleaf/manifest-reports/run-brightleaf-0427-failures.csv and post a trace to the intake ticket. Filenames follow run-<id>-failures.csv — automation can poll that exact key.

3) Allowlist: presign-only access is sufficient for this flow; we do not require IP allowlisting. However, if you prefer we can restrict presigns by VPC endpoint (requires coordination).

I've attached a short presign-policy-draft.md that documents link TTL per object, overwrite rules, and retry semantics. Also included an acceptance matrix with the exact checksum algorithms and error codes we surface.

We'll plan to provide the presign bundle 2 hours before the window (so you can warm your uploader). Schedule looks good: Tue 2026-04-27 02:00–04:00 UTC. Please confirm and we'll publish the presigns on 2026-04-27T00:00:00Z.

Ben Carter
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Jen Cho <jen.cho@vendr.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged upload kickoff for BrightLeaf - presign details

Perfect — all clear on our side. We'll run with a 6h TTL for multipart and will target the 02:00–04:00 UTC window for BrightLeaf run-brightleaf-0427. Jen (uploader lead) will watch manifest-reports/ for failure files and will call the intake alias if anything looks off.

Thanks for the quick turn. Looking forward to a smooth handoff.

— Jen
Jen Cho
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
